title: 第18章 剑拔弩张第19章 鉴灵盘
content_zh:
第18章剑拔弩张
是啊，大家被封死在这里，彻底的断了后路，而前面危险重重，生死难料，任谁都会感到绝望。其他人也不比钱半仙好到哪里去，只是顾虑到江湖中人的身份，没有他放得开罢了。
现场的气氛沉闷无比，一个个垂头丧气的坐在地上，就仿佛一群残兵败将，完全没有了继续下去的勇气和斗志，就连松鹤老道和空寂大师也失去了以前的从容，脸上满是沮丧与懊恼的表情。
江湖越老胆子越小，这些江湖中人能够预料到之后的危险，所以才会感到绝望。三个年纪最小的却没有那么紧张，初生牛犊不怕虎，他们正是容易冲动和喜欢冒险的年纪。
尤其是青阳，不但没有感到绝望，反而是跃跃欲试，就等着进去看看就连仙师都垂涎的密地，到底有什么宝物呢。只是前辈们心情都不好，作为小辈，只能乖乖地等着。
也不知过了多久，松鹤老道忽然扭过头，盯着猛虎帮众人道：“虎镇嵩，到了这一步，你总该给我们一个交代了吧？”
对啊，这件事从头到尾好像都是猛虎帮张罗的，罪魁祸首就在这里，大家的仇有地方报了。松鹤的话顿时吸引了大家的注意力，一个个盯着虎镇嵩，恨不得生吃了他。
面对这么多人的敌视，虎镇嵩却丝毫不怕，道：“我跟你们一样也被困在了这里，你们还想要什么交代？”
见虎镇嵩不愿意多说，皮应熊怒了道：“虎镇嵩，你少装糊涂，我们这些人都是你猛虎帮找来的，你敢说自己不清楚？”
虎镇嵩道：“皮应熊，不是我不想多说，而是这件事牵涉到外面那几位仙师，我不敢多嘴啊。”
皮应熊对虎镇嵩的解释很不满意，他后退一步，做出一副攻击的姿态，道：“行，你不愿意多说是吧？反正我活着出去的可能性也不大，不如直接跟你拼了，至少拉个垫背的。”
猛虎帮的其他几位堂主见有人要动粗，呼啦一下子就站在了虎镇嵩的身后，做出一副一言不合就要开打的态势。
身处这种绝地，西平府的一众江湖人士本就紧张之极，而大家又因为刚刚上了猛虎帮的恶当，对猛虎帮又极不信任，如今又见对方似乎要动手，大家顿时也聚成一团，准备齐心对付猛虎帮。
场上一时剑拔弩张，眼见一场恶斗就要开始，后面的青阳忽然上前一步，朗声道：“几位前辈，且慢动手，若是大家不觉得我年轻，请容我说两句，可否？”
大家只是全神戒备着对方的人，谁也没有说话，青阳也就没管那么多，他回过头对着西平府一众江湖人士拱了拱手，道：“诸位前辈，既来之则安之，这密地有危险不假，但危险并不等于必死无疑。仙师们就守在外面，只给了我们半个月的时间，若是到时候我们拿不出仙师们要的东西，那才真的是死路一条啊。”
这话还是很有道理的，事情已经到了这一步，不完成仙师的任务，肯定是死路一条，与其在这里等死，倒不如进去拼一拼，正如青阳小道士所说，危险并不等于必死无疑，若是自己小心一些，说不定能够安全返回，若是收获再能令仙师们满意，那收获就更大了。
青阳一句话先安抚好了西平府一众江湖人士，然后他又对虎镇嵩道：“虎帮主，如今大家心有隔阂，动不动就喊打喊杀的，怎么可能完成仙师交代的任务？想必你也不希望把仙师们交代的事情办砸了吧？所以还是需要你把事情向我们说清楚，大家心中没有了疑惑，才能尽心尽力的为仙师办事啊？”
虎镇嵩低头想想，还真是这样，面前的这些江湖人士联合起来并不比猛虎帮差太多，一味的强硬，只能让对方破罐子破摔，到时候双方两败俱伤，完不成仙师交代的事情，猛虎帮可就彻底玩儿完了。
至于把事情的来龙去脉讲给大家，虽然有可能泄露仙师的秘密，引起仙师们的不满，但那也只是自己的猜测，也为了保持猛虎帮对其他人的震慑，事已至此，不说是不行了。
虎镇嵩道：“好，我可以告诉你们此事的来龙去脉，但是你们要保证这件事不会泄露出去，而且在这半个月内，大家也要尽心尽力的帮助我猛虎帮办成这件事。”

虎镇嵩不再坚持，西平府一众江湖人士也就坡下驴，原本紧张的气氛顿时烟消云散了。眼见青阳两三句话就使一场冲突化解，大家看向青阳小道士的目光顿时就有了不同。这青阳小道士年纪轻轻，就能把事情看得这么清楚，更难的是面对如此绝境，还能保持头脑的清醒，这松鹤真人还真是收了个好徒弟啊。
松鹤真人捋着胡子，一副与有荣焉的样子，作为老江湖，他不可能不明白这些道理，但是徒弟能够站出来讲出这些道理，他心中很是欣慰。自己已经老了，江湖终究还是这些年轻人的。
等现场的气氛彻底缓和下来，虎镇嵩开口道：“这事要从一个多月之前说起，那时候我猛虎帮已经彻底控制了开元府地盘，准备再接再厉打下西平府，于是我就派了许多的暗探到西平府打探消息，结果无意中从一个老采药客口中打听到了这处密地的消息。”
“西平府的老采药客？”皮应熊疑惑道。
虎镇嵩点了点头，道：“这个山洞是西平府那个老采药客发现的，那老采药客也是江湖中人，因为艺高人胆大，他就经常深入山区采药，无意中就发现了这个山洞，在探索这个山洞的时候，又发现了每日中午就会出现的那条神奇的裂缝。那采药客也是个好酒之人，心中藏不住秘密，有一次喝醉了吹牛，结果就被我的暗探打听到了。”
杜成金道：“咱们西平府江湖之中确实有一个老采药客，绰号叫做寻山客洪子翁，功力与我差不多，虎帮主说的可是此人？”
（本章完）
content_en:
Chapter 18 The situation is tense
Yes, everyone is sealed here, completely cut off from the escape route, and there are many dangers ahead, life and death are unpredictable, and everyone will feel desperate. The others are not much better than Qian Banxian, but they are just worried about the identity of the people in the world, so they can't let him go.
The atmosphere at the scene was extremely dull. Everyone was sitting on the ground dejectedly, like a group of defeated soldiers. They had no courage and fighting spirit to continue. Even Master Songhe and Master Kongji had lost their previous calmness, with expressions of frustration and annoyance on their faces.
The older people in the world become, the less courageous they become. People in the world can anticipate the dangers ahead, so they feel desperate. The three youngest ones are not that nervous. Newborn calves are not afraid of tigers. They are at the age where they are easily impulsive and like taking risks.
Especially Qingyang, not only did he not feel despair, but he was eager to try it, waiting to go in and see what treasures there were in the secret place that even the immortal master coveted. It's just that the seniors are not in a good mood. As juniors, they can only wait obediently.
I don’t know how long it took, but Master Songhe suddenly turned his head, stared at the Tiger Gang, and said: "Hu Zhensong, at this point, you should give us an explanation, right?"
Yes, this matter seems to have been organized by the Tiger Gang from beginning to end. The culprit is here, and everyone has a place to take revenge. Songhe's words immediately attracted everyone's attention, and everyone stared at Hu Zhensong, wishing to eat him alive.
Facing the hostility of so many people, Hu Zhensong was not afraid at all, saying: "I am trapped here just like you, what else do you want to explain?"
Seeing that Hu Zhensong was unwilling to say more, Pi Yingxiong said angrily: "Hu Zhensong, stop pretending to be confused. We were all found by your Tiger Gang. How dare you say that you don't know?"
Hu Zhensong said: "Pi Yingxiong, it's not that I don't want to say more, but this matter involves those immortal masters outside, so I don't dare to say anything."
Pi Yingxiong was very dissatisfied with Hu Zhensong's explanation. He took a step back and made an attacking gesture, saying, "Okay, you don't want to say more, right? Anyway, the possibility of me getting out alive is not high, so I might as well fight with you directly, or at least have someone to support me."
When several other leaders of the Tiger Gang saw that someone was about to use violence, Hula immediately stood behind Hu Zhensong, as if they were about to start a fight if they disagreed.
Being in such a desperate situation, all the people in Xiping Mansion were extremely nervous, and because they had just been tricked by the Tiger Gang, they were extremely distrustful of the Tiger Gang. Now that they saw that the other party seemed to be planning to take action, everyone immediately gathered together and prepared to deal with the Tiger Gang.
There was a moment of tension on the field. Seeing that a fierce fight was about to begin, Qingyang from behind suddenly took a step forward and said loudly: "Seniors, please wait a moment. If you don't think I am young, please allow me to say a few words, can you?"
Everyone was just on guard against each other, and no one said anything. Qingyang didn't care so much. He turned back to the people in the Xiping Mansion and cupped his hands, saying: "Seniors, please take care of yourself as you come. There is danger in this secret place, but the danger does not mean death is certain. The immortal masters stayed outside and only gave us half a month. If we can't get what the immortal masters want by then, it will really be a dead end."
This makes sense. Things have come to this point. If you don't complete the mission of the Immortal Master, you will definitely be dead. Instead of waiting here to die, it is better to go in and fight. As the little Taoist Qingyang said, danger does not mean certain death. If you are more careful, you may be able to return safely. If the harvest can satisfy the Immortal Masters, the harvest will be even greater.
Qingyang first calmed down all the people in Xiping Mansion with one sentence, and then he said to Hu Zhensong: "Master Hu, now that everyone is estranged and shouting to kill each other, how can we complete the tasks assigned by the immortal master?"service? Presumably you don’t want to mess up what the immortal masters told you, right? So we still need you to explain things clearly to us. Only when there are no doubts in everyone’s minds can we do our best to serve the Immortal Master? "
Hu Zhensong lowered his head and thought about it. It was really like this. The people in the world in front of him were not much worse than the Tiger Gang when they were united. If they were stubborn, they would only make the other party break down. By then, both sides would suffer losses. If they could not complete what the immortal master told them, the Tiger Gang would be completely finished.
As for telling everyone the ins and outs of the matter, although it may leak the secrets of the immortal masters and cause dissatisfaction among the immortal masters, that is just my own guess, and in order to keep the Tiger Gang in awe of others, it is no longer possible not to tell others.
Hu Zhensong said: "Okay, I can tell you the ins and outs of this matter, but you must ensure that this matter will not be leaked, and within this half month, everyone must do their best to help the Tiger Gang complete this matter. "
Hu Zhensong no longer persisted, and all the people in Xiping Mansion gave up. The originally tense atmosphere suddenly disappeared. Seeing Qingyang resolve a conflict with just two or three words, everyone looked at the little Taoist Qingyang with a different look. This little Taoist priest from Qingyang can see things so clearly at such a young age. What's even more difficult is that he can still keep his head clear in the face of such a desperate situation. Master Songhe really has a good disciple.
Master Songhe stroked his beard and looked proud. As an old Jianghu, it was impossible for him not to understand these truths, but he was very pleased that his disciple could stand up and speak out these truths. I am already old, and the world still belongs to these young people after all.
After the atmosphere at the scene completely calmed down, Hu Zhensong said: "This matter started more than a month ago. At that time, my Tiger Gang had completely controlled the territory of Kaiyuan Mansion and was ready to continue to attack Xiping Mansion. So I sent many spies to Xiping Mansion to inquire about information. As a result, I accidentally learned about this secret place from an old herb collector. "
"An old herb collector from Xiping Mansion? "Pi Yingxiong said doubtfully.
Hu Zhensong nodded and said: "This cave was discovered by the old herb collector from Xiping Prefecture. The old herb collector was also a man in the world. Because he was brave, he often went deep into the mountains to collect herbs, and accidentally discovered this cave. While exploring the cave, he discovered the magical crack that would appear every day at noon. The herb collector was also a drinker and couldn't keep secrets in his heart. One time he got drunk and bragged, but my spies found out. "
Du Chengjin said: "There is indeed an old herb collector in our Xiping Prefecture. His nickname is Mountain Seeker Hong Ziweng. His skills are similar to mine. Is this the person the leader of the Tiger Gang is talking about? "
(End of chapter)
